## About
Select Auto Parts is a used auto parts yard in Clearwater, FL. We carry late model import and domestic auto and truck parts, and our team will help you find the right one whether you search online, visit in person, or give us a call.
Our customers have rated us 4.6 on Google from 397 reviews. One reviewer put it this way: we sold him the part he needed, not the part he thought he needed. Another said the staff helped load everything onto his trailer.
If you're not local, that's fine too. We ship anywhere in the U.S.A.

## Services
- Discounted used auto parts: Quality used parts at prices that make sense.
- Free local delivery on motors and transmissions: Buying a motor or transmission? We deliver it locally at no charge.
- Delivery to all 50 states: Not near Clearwater? Delivery is available wherever you are in the country.

## FAQ
Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. We offer warranty options, including a 90 day warranty.

Q: Can I look for parts before I come in?
A: Yes. You can search our inventory online by part, run a multi-part search, or search by images. You can also call and one of our sales representatives will help.

Q: Do you speak Spanish?
A: We do. Call or stop by and talk with us in Spanish.
